sections.title: The school that looks like a factory

items.q: Why does a foreigner read a 21:20 lit building as a factory?
items.a: They never ran a **科举 OS**. US bells he cites: high school ~14:20, elementary 09:00–15:30. 十余年 + half a family's wealth on **one exam** does not parse.

items.q: Why is exam mania not a sudden parenting fad?
items.a: [[keju-selection-inertia]]: 世卿世禄 → 察举 → 九品中正 → 科举. Abolished **1905**, ~three generations. 中举 bought a post, tax-exempt land, clan cover. 范进 is the status flip.

items.q: What is 高考 on the parent ledger?
items.a: [[gaokao-as-family-investment]]: 15–20 years, tens/hundreds of thousands RMB. Chicken-parenting (老破小, human walls, poisoned frogs) is **loss-protection**. Harvest of ¥4,000/month or 家里蹲 is a write-off.

items.q: What does he do with the 95M depression cite?
items.a: 2023 **95M**, **30.28%** under 18 → ~**28.76M** minors; **1 in 10** in junior/senior-high. Caption 乘风飞翔 = suicide. Treat the counts as **his citations**.

sections.title: Keep the filter, end the monopoly

items.q: Why do college kids look '清澈而愚蠢'?
items.a: [[exam-only-life-script]]. K–12 only the paper. Ages 3–22 nobody taught clubs, dating, earning. Grad school / 家里蹲 is a hide. Then society says 眼高手低.

items.q: When does 应试 stop working?
items.a: [[catch-up-exam-vs-frontier-education]]: latecomer can copy a mapped job list. A would-be leader cannot if games/sport/interest are 洪水猛兽. He still ranks 应试 above US 快乐教育.
